name: Mitten Extracts | 2g Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Runtz + Pineapple Express Haze
description:
Two legendary flavor profiles come together in one device. Candy-sweet Runtz blends with tropical pineapple citrus for a smooth, uplifting experience that’s fruity, bright, and endlessly enjoyable.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
